“My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
Don’t consider your servant a wicked woman; for I have been speaking out of the abundance of my complaint and my…
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed.
Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.
I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.

Then he said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch with me.”
As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, saying, “Help, my lord, O king!”
He said, “If Yahweh doesn’t help you, where could I get help for you? From of the threshing floor, or from the wine…
Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving…
Moses spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

translations.web: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?
translations.bsb: Is my complaint against a man? Then why should I not be impatient?
translations.kjv: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?
translations.asv: As for me, is my complaint to man? And why should I not be impatient?
